description: Environment Agency registrations and a UK Sanctions List check for one company. Waste carrier / broker / dealer status and expiry, permits, exemptions and enforcement actions (England), plus whether the company's number, name or former names match an entity on the UK Sanctions List (a lead to confirm, never a finding). 2 credits. Use this for environmental permits and a sanctions screen; for other registers use aml_register, sra_check, cqc_check, charity_check or sponsor_licence.

company.description: A UK company number (8 characters, such as 00502851 or SC123456) is surest; a name also works and goes to the closest registered company, which the reply names. Use company_search first when a name could mean several companies.
